content.comment_body: Apologies for asking again, but I'm still struggling with this issue. I need to count pulses from an MTL pulse isolator that has a positive and negative output. The barrier is receiving pulses, but I'm unsure how to connect the signals to the [product_name].
Could you specify the exact model of the MTL isolator?
It's the 5032 pulse isolator. I can purchase a different model if necessary. I need to count pulses from a solvent dispenser, with 350 pulses per liter.
The 5032 pulse isolator features an open collector PNP output. You can connect the output to the [product_name] using either a pull-up or pull-down resistor.
